verdict.rationale: A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 document covering the FireHydrant API (servers https://api.firehydrant.io/, tags across Call Routes, Permissions, Roles, Audit Events and more) is published in the official MCP server repository. However, it ships as a Speakeasy build artifact of the MCP server rather than a documented spec download, and probes of the standard OpenAPI paths on the docs site all returned 404. missing for 10: an officially documented, first-party OpenAPI download linked from the API reference, confirmation that the artifact covers the full API surface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official freshworks-oss/firehydrant-mcp repository publishes a FireHydrant OpenAPI document (.speakeasy/openapi.output.yaml): openapi "3.0.1"
